tickets.title: Review tax document collection for completeness
tickets.text:
Review the collected tax documents against the expected evidence list before marking the file complete.

Criteria to confirm:
- Prior-year tax return is available if needed for carryovers, estimated payments, or basis details.
- W-2, 1099, K-1, retirement distribution, Social Security, interest, dividend, and capital gain documents are present as applicable.
- Brokerage tax packages include corrected versions if the custodian issued updates.
- Estimated tax payment records show payment amount, jurisdiction, and relative payment period.
- Charitable giving records include acknowledgment letters where required.
- Mortgage interest, property tax, education, childcare, medical, and business expense records are included when relevant.
- Equity compensation activity has supporting grant, vesting, exercise, sale, and withholding evidence when applicable.
- Documents are labeled clearly and stored in the appropriate secure folder.
- Missing items are listed with owner, source, and next follow-up action.

Focus on adoption-related tax records, childcare deposit evidence, dependent information, and employer benefit election documents needed for CPA preparation.
